d: Company Description Dome, established in 2008, is a leading company in the Kingdom of Bahrain specializing in interior design, project execution, and the manufacturing of building and finishing solutions. The company operates through an integrated business model that unites creative design, engineering expertise, and in-house production to deliver end-to-end project services from concept to completion. Dome’s specialized departments cover design and engineering supervision, marble and stone fabrication and installation, and custom woodwork manufacturing, enabling a wide range of interior and exterior finishing solutions. By combining design quality, precise execution, and high-grade materials, Dome has built a reputation as a trusted partner for fully integrated projects. The company is committed to professional and engineering standards to ensure optimal results for every client.

Role Description The Cutlist Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Tubli, responsible for preparing accurate cutlists and material breakdowns for joinery, custom woodwork, and related finishing works. The role includes interpreting technical drawings, designs, and specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions, and cutting patterns. The Cutlist Specialist will coordinate closely with design, engineering, and production teams to optimize material usage, minimize waste, and support efficient manufacturing workflows. Daily tasks involve detailed data entry, updating and maintaining cutlist records, verifying measurements, and ensuring alignment with project timelines and quality standards. The role also supports continuous improvement by identifying discrepancies, suggesting adjustments to designs or processes, and contributing to streamlined production planning.
q: li

li

li

li
Commitment to safety, quality standards, and continuous process improvement.
